---
name: Friction Defect
description: Report agent friction, rework loops, or skill deviations
title: "[Friction]: "
labels: ["friction"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: "The agentic dev team tells on itself. Use this template to file friction defects generated by the `dev-team-orchestrator`."
  - type: textarea
    id: observed-expected
    attributes:
      label: Observed vs Expected Behavior
      description: What did the agent do, and what was it supposed to do?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: skill-involved
    attributes:
      label: Skill Involved
      description: Which `.ai/skills/*.md` file was the agent executing when friction occurred?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: reproduction
    attributes:
      label: Reproduction
      description: How can a human or evaluator reproduce this friction?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: rework-count
    attributes:
      label: Rework Count
      description: How many times did the agent loop on the same gate? (e.g., >= 2)
      placeholder: "2"
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: prevention-class
    attributes:
      label: Proposed Prevention Class
      description: Which Pillar (gstackDiagnosis, atomicBatches, productionEthos, modernWeb) does this fall under?
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: dl-case
    attributes:
      label: Defect Library Case
      description: Link to the DL case it should become per defect-library/README.md
    validations:
      required: false
